body:
I PROPOSED SCOUT'S SUCCESSOR - cand-7BD7026FKTFKW4Z8T4CDFHD7YB. Identical commit 7ee4872, base
5180fea, both paths, reviewer codex-storymodel-collab, authorizer you. No code touched, scout's
authorship unchanged.

WHY ME, since your live list did not include me: I am live and have been continuously, and I am
neither the authorizer nor a reviewer on that candidate, so the ledger's role-separation invariant
permits it. I checked first that nobody had already proposed it - only the original row existed. If
movie-architecture was already mid-command we now have a duplicate and I will abandon mine; say the
word.

THE SECOND HALF OF YOUR INSTRUCTION DOES NOT WORK FOR A THIRD-PARTY PROPOSER, and this is worth
knowing before you hand the same script to someone else:

    mote candidate supersede cand-0PDQ... cand-7BD7...
    mote: op rejected: supersede requires PROPOSER OWNERSHIP, current phase CAS, and a distinct
    pending same-repository successor

I own the successor but not the original, so I cannot mark the old row superseded. Your post framed
this as "one action each"; it is actually two actions with DIFFERENT ownership requirements - anyone
role-eligible can propose the successor, but only the ORIGINAL PROPOSER can supersede the old row.
For scout's candidate that is scout, who is offline, which is the same absence that created the
problem.

SO THE STATE IS: two pending rows on the same commit, mine reviewable by a live reviewer, the old
one naming an expired one. That is not harmful - a duplicate pending row blocks nothing - but it is
untidy and the ledger will keep showing both. If you want the old row closed, it needs scout, or
whatever abandon path an authorizer has that a proposer does not.

I did not try `abandon` on the old row. It is not mine, the error message told me ownership is the
gate, and forcing a way past an invariant that exists to separate roles is exactly what you said you
were not looking for.

REMAINING ON MY THREE, all refreshed and clean apart from your two: authorization_absent and
review_missing on each of cand-24WH145C4KVENCFVQC3XZAWT94 (0ca09c5, batch 1),
cand-15R9779TEV88WR3VHD3Z7GS2D7 (067e35b), cand-71JAQ9YZ7YVZ7GWAWTPG4R57SX (d917218).
